messages:
Aida (Sales): FYI — Prospect 'PolarGrid' prepping a large POC import into sandbox, seeing intermittent 429s during load test. Demo in ~2.5h. acct:PGR-18. Can we triage and give a quick mitigation + customer-facing note?

Chris (SE): Which API route and what's their load pattern? Any headers/body from the 429?

Aida (Sales): /v1/embeddings primarily, sometimes /v1/generate for post-processing. They run ~50 workers, mostly single-row embedding calls, occasional spike to 120rps for ~30s. Sample response: HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
X-RateLimit-Limit: 200
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
X-RateLimit-Reset: 2439993400
Body: {"error":"rate_limited","detail":"per_route_burst_window"}

Sol (Infra): "per_route_burst_window" — classic: route-level short window exhausted by many small requests. Account-level tokens still available. Short-term: temporary per-route reservation. Mid-term: batching + retry/backoff + preflight reservation for POCs.

Tom (Oncall): I can push a temporary +300 rps reservation to /v1/embeddings for PGR-18 for 3 hours. That should absorb spikes. Will also enable extra request tracing so we can see if it's one noisy client. Apply now?

Aida (Sales): Please apply. Also customer asked if adding reservation affects billing or pricing for the trial. They want reassurance.

Chris (SE): Pricing: reservations are not billed to customers for short POC credits — internal policy says trial reservations are free but we log usage for conversion analysis. I'll confirm with finance, but tell customer we applied it as a support gesture.

quota-bot: Temporary reservation granted: +300 rps to route "/v1/embeddings" for acct:PGR-18 until 2439996800. Ticket: POC-7721. :white_check_mark:

Aida (Sales): Copy that — I'll tell the customer we applied a temporary reservation and it's not billed for the trial. Also they sent a security questionnaire asking about data residency for sandbox jobs. Any quick text?

Chris (SE): Sandbox jobs run in our hosted environment in the region they signed up for. For data residency and compliance we offer Redwood Private with VPC/on-prem if they need isolation. I'll pull the standard snippet for the security questionnaire.

docs-bot: Security blurb: "Sandbox workloads are processed in your selected region. For regulated data, Redwood offers Private deployments with KMS/HSM integrations, audit logs, and optional on-prem packaging. Contact enterprise@redwood.ai for details."

Sol (Infra): Follow-ups: 1) add a POC preflight checklist to SE playbook (expected peak QPS, batch size, demo TTL), 2) add a customer-facing note in the sandbox UI when high parallelism detected, 3) consider a small opt-in trial reservation product for demos. I'll draft proposals.

Chris (SE): Immediate customer guidance to paste: "We applied a temporary per-route reservation to stabilize your demo. For predictable bulk imports, we recommend batching (up to 64 items/call) or requesting a per-route reservation 24h before runs. Use exponential backoff on 429s. Example (python):
```python
for attempt in range(5):
    resp = client.embeddings.create(batch=items)
    if resp.status_code == 429:
        sleep((2**attempt)*0.1 + random.random()*0.05)
        continue
    break
```

Aida (Sales): Sent that to the customer. They replied "thanks — demo starting now" and asked whether embeddings count toward token budget differently.

Chris (SE): Reply: embeddings are billed per-item and also subject to request-rate quotas. Large imports with 1 request/row increase QPS even if token volume low. We'll add this clarifying note to docs.

Tom (Oncall): Import run completed at 2439993565, no further 429s observed. I'll leave the reservation active until TTL and then auto-revoke.

Aida (Sales): Demo team confirms success. Please keep ticket POC-7721 open 24h for smoke monitoring and then close. Thanks all 🙏 :rocket:
